description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the 'ReportGeneratorService' related to the PIM (Personal Information Management) plugin in the OrangeHRM project. It sets up a service instance, initializes test data, and verifies the behavior of the report generator DAO retrieval.

classes.name: PimDefinedReportServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class that tests the ReportGeneratorService within the PIM plugin context.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by instantiating the report generator service and loading test fixtures.

methods.name: testGetReportGeneratorDao
methods.description: Asserts that the 'getReportGeneratorDao' method returns an instance of 'ReportGeneratorDao'.
